_source: See references/constants.md. Graha drishti is whole-house, cast forward from a planet's own house -- not degree-based like Western aspects.
_rule: Every graha aspects the house 7 positions forward from its own (universal). Mars, Jupiter, and Saturn additionally cast special aspects, listed below as house-offsets counted forward from the planet's own house (e.g. Mars offset 4 means '4th house from Mars's own position').

nodesSpecialAspects._note: Disputed across schools. Some traditions give Rahu/Ketu the same special aspects as Jupiter and Mars respectively (their traditional functional analogues); others give nodes only the universal 7th. Controlled by EngineSettings.nodesHaveSpecialAspects -- default false.
